templates.name: System Morph
templates.summary: One persistent subject continuously unfolds into a distributed system before releasing an ordinary information document.

identity.informationGoal: Explain how one product, material, or idea expands into a complete system without replacing the visual subject between chapters.
identity.composition: A full-viewport persistent subject transforms from a single object into a spatial sample field; the immersive stage then ends and releases a stable technical ledger.
identity.interaction: Native vertical document progress continuously controls subject scale, density, distribution, and camera distance. Reverse scrolling restores every intermediate composition.
identity.semantic3d: The spatial multiplication shows how one unit becomes a family of modules and which properties remain shared.

invariants: One visual subject remains identifiable from the first frame through the distributed system state.
Composition parameters interpolate continuously and reversibly.
The immersive stage has an explicit release into ordinary information.
Each of the three states produces a distinct information result.
Mobile serializes the sample field without hiding content.
Reduced motion exposes three stable poses and the full ledger.

compatibility.browser: Modern browser with WebGL2 recommended; readable fallback required
compatibility.framework: Framework-neutral contract with a react-r3f adapter

templates.name: Foreground Product Journey
templates.summary: A scroll-led information page with a persistent foreground product crossing editorial chapters.

identity.informationGoal: Explain one product through a sequence of readable editorial chapters.
identity.composition: A persistent product subject occupies the foreground while chapter-specific image, color, type, and detail layers move behind and around it.
identity.interaction: Vertical wheel or touch scroll advances a continuous normalized story state. Chapters are state ranges, not isolated pages.
identity.semantic3d: Model rotation, scale, material emphasis, and camera distance reveal the feature discussed by the active chapter.

invariants: The product subject remains visually in front of chapter backgrounds until the contract-defined footer exit.
The subject follows a continuous path across chapter boundaries without teleporting.
Each major 3D state change corresponds to a content claim.
Primary copy remains readable and is never accidentally crossed by the subject.
Mobile uses its own composition and trajectory rather than scaling desktop coordinates.
The document remains navigable and understandable with reduced motion enabled.

adapters.note: Planned; the v0 package contains the experience contract only.

templates.provenance: Original framework-neutral contract authored for WebMotion; no third-party brand assets or implementation code included.
templates.prompt: 使用 WebMotion 的 foreground-product 模板创建网页。请交互式询问内容、素材、语言和轨迹要求。

templates.name: Fullscreen State Machine
templates.summary: An internal full-screen scroller advances a persistent instrument through three discrete states while the document itself stays fixed.

identity.informationGoal: Turn wheel or touch input into a small number of explicit full-screen states when ordinary document displacement would weaken the story.
identity.composition: A fixed stage owns the viewport. One persistent object, one large copy block, a state rail, and an explicit exit change together at three discrete positions.
identity.interaction: The document remains fixed while a focusable internal scroller owns progress. State buttons can move between stops and the final state exposes an exit.
identity.semantic3d: Instrument orientation and highlighted strings explain tension, resonance, and release as named states.

invariants: The document does not move while the internal stage is active.
Exactly three named states remain reachable by wheel, touch, keyboard, and buttons.
Object and copy change as one state transaction.
The final state exposes an explicit exit from the internal scroller.
Internal scrolling never traps keyboard focus permanently.
Reduced motion uses direct state changes without continuous camera travel.

templates.name: Spatial Editorial Journey
templates.summary: A long-form editorial journey with a 2D-to-3D terrain morph, a continuous horizontal spatial traverse, and distinct information-first chapter compositions.

identity.informationGoal: Explain a long-form editorial subject through a continuous spatial journey while keeping reading and navigation primary.
identity.composition: A full-viewport WebGL world sits behind seven materially different editorial chapters: an opening field, a 2D-to-3D source transformation, an embedded horizontal traverse, and a sequence of photographic, archival, typographic, particle, map, and closing compositions.
identity.interaction: Native vertical wheel, touch, and keyboard scrolling drive one continuous story state. One declared chapter maps vertical travel into a reversible horizontal editorial traverse without capturing or replacing native scrolling.
identity.semantic3d: The opening source image becomes displaced terrain; camera movement reveals the same spatial system from new evidence-bearing viewpoints; later particle and material states explain the active chapter rather than acting as a decorative viewer.

invariants: The document remains an information website with readable headings, body copy, facts, captions, and route navigation.
Every chapter has a distinct composition role; changing only navigation or copy placement is not sufficient.
The 2D source image and the 3D terrain are two states of the same subject and must morph continuously.
The vertical-to-horizontal traverse remains scrubbed by native document progress and is reversible at every point.
Adjacent camera trajectories share an explicit boundary keyframe; camera position and gaze cannot switch formulas on different endpoints.
No important copy or control is accidentally obscured by WebGL, images, or transitional panels.
Desktop and mobile use separately authored camera paths and compositions.
Reduced motion disables smoothing and exposes every chapter in a stable readable state.

compatibility.browser: Modern browser with WebGL2 recommended; readable reduced-motion content remains required
compatibility.framework: Framework-neutral contract with a verified React Three Fiber adapter

templates.provenance: Original WebMotion framework-neutral contract, React Three Fiber adapter, generated demonstration imagery, fictional copy, and procedural 3D. No third-party brand assets, source-site media, or copied implementation code are included.

templates.name: Guided Camera Route
templates.summary: Document scroll drives a continuous camera itinerary through room scale, object detail, and evidence plaque stops.

identity.informationGoal: Guide readers through spatial evidence in a fixed order without turning the page into a free-roaming game.
identity.composition: A persistent full-screen spatial corridor sits behind three materially different stops: overview, close detail, and evidence record.
identity.interaction: Native document scroll moves a damped camera along a continuous route. Declared stops align copy, camera, and evidence while remaining reversible.
identity.semantic3d: Camera distance and viewing angle establish context, reveal surface evidence, and conclude on searchable factual information.

invariants: The route remains continuous through every stop boundary.
Every camera stop delivers a distinct searchable information result.
The user cannot enter free-roam or lose the route.
Camera position and gaze share explicit boundary keyframes.
Mobile uses a separately framed route with copy below the visual field.
Reduced motion shows stable stop images and complete DOM records.

templates.name: Narrative Spatial Handoff
templates.summary: A long scroll narrative visibly ends before control passes to a clickable globe or hotspot index.

identity.informationGoal: Build enough context through narrative progression, then let readers directly select places, records, or nodes.
identity.composition: A typographic longform story occupies the first act. A clear threshold introduces a separate full-screen spatial index with hotspots and a record panel.
identity.interaction: Native scroll owns the story. After an explicit handoff, pointer and keyboard selection own the spatial index; further scrolling does not change selection.
identity.semantic3d: The globe encodes geographic distribution and makes selected records spatially comparable.

invariants: The narrative visibly concludes before the index accepts spatial selection.
Scroll does not silently continue controlling the index.
Every hotspot has an equivalent DOM button and record.
Selection updates the globe and information panel together.
Mobile serializes the globe, hotspot list, and record panel.
Reduced motion keeps selection usable with a static globe pose.

templates.name: Editorial Media Rhythm
templates.summary: Typography, media density, whitespace, and one bounded spatial insert create depth without a persistent 3D object.

identity.informationGoal: Build a premium editorial information page when continuous 3D would distract from reading.
identity.composition: Large typographic cover, full-bleed media field, essay spread, bounded spatial insert, touchable media cabinet, quote, and credits each use different density.
identity.interaction: Ordinary document flow remains primary. Media and type enter through native scrolling; one embedded 3D figure answers a local question and then releases the reader.
identity.semantic3d: The bounded spatial insert demonstrates material continuity only where the essay requires spatial evidence.

invariants: No persistent 3D object follows the reader through the document.
At least five distinct density rhythms are visible.
The embedded 3D figure has a local information job and bounded duration.
The document remains complete if the spatial insert fails.
Mobile turns the media cabinet into native horizontal touch without affecting document scroll.
Reduced motion preserves the same editorial sequence.

templates.name: Spatial Product Document
templates.summary: One spatial product hero explains a structural promise, then yields to an ordinary specifications and evidence document.

identity.informationGoal: Use 3D to clarify one product structure without making every section depend on a persistent canvas.
identity.composition: A split but asymmetric hero pairs product copy with one contained spatial object. Facts, specifications, and evidence continue as conventional DOM sections.
identity.interaction: Ordinary document flow. The hero object uses bounded ambient motion and one CTA scrolls to standard specifications.
identity.semantic3d: The spatial arch explains how one continuous scan captures a full structure instead of isolated samples.

invariants: The spatial object is contained to the hero and does not follow into specifications.
The hero makes one structural product claim visible.
Facts and specifications are standard searchable DOM content.
The page remains useful when WebGL is unavailable.
Mobile places the spatial object before the copy and preserves the CTA.
Reduced motion leaves a stable product pose.

templates.name: Pre-rendered Spatial Document
templates.summary: Pre-rendered spatial plates provide visual scale and atmosphere inside an ordinary corporate information document with no WebGL runtime.

identity.informationGoal: Deliver reliable spatial storytelling when realtime interaction adds cost but no additional information value.
identity.composition: Large typographic cover, one pre-rendered hero plate, text spread, two spatial detail plates, operations copy, and technical record follow normal document flow.
identity.interaction: Native document scrolling and ordinary image loading only. Media can be replaced by video, image sequences, or responsive pictures without a realtime scene.
identity.semantic3d: Pre-rendered plates communicate infrastructure scale, sectional organization, and material detail while DOM content carries claims and specifications.

invariants: No WebGL canvas or realtime scene runtime is included.
Every spatial plate has descriptive alternative text and a caption.
The document remains understandable if media fails to load.
Media does not capture wheel, touch, or keyboard input.
Mobile uses responsive crops and serialized copy.
Reduced motion removes optional playback while preserving still plates.
